contentText: Hungary’s president announced on Tuesday that the next parliamentary election will be held on April 12th. Although the official campaign begins in a month, the race is already shaping up to be the most competitive in a generation, with polls showing a tight contest between current Prime Minister Viktor Orbán and his closest challenger. The election is being closely monitored for its potential implications for both Ukraine and the European Union, reports Monte Francis.
